ei.title: The Social Role of TV Sitcoms

fullPassage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as evolving conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been addressed through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more acceptable than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. In this way, the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means to encourage acceptance of a more pluralistic and tolerant society.

questions.passage: Since their start in the early 1950s U.S. television sitcoms have charted many of the social conflicts in U.S. society: civil rights, women's rights in the home and in the workplace, children's rights, immigration and multiculturalism, as well as ①<u>evolving</u> conceptions of the family. Each of these issues has been ②<u>addressed</u> through humour in a way that has helped to make more progressive values more ③<u>acceptable</u> than previously. Often a character, usually someone marked as a bigot, resisted one or more of these developments and was then made to appear ridiculous. They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or both. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ resisting → resisted. 'was then made'와 and로 병렬되므로 과거형 resisted가 필요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① evolving: 현재분사로 conceptions 수식. 적절.
❌ ② addressed: 현재완료 수동태 has been addressed. 적절.
❌ ③ acceptable: 형용사. make+O+C 보어. 적절.
✅ ④ resisting → resisted: and로 was then made와 병렬. 과거형 필요.
det.tip: and로 연결된 동사는 같은 시제. resisted ... and was then made

They were cut down either through their own stupidity, a brief scolding from others, or ③<u>both</u>. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② marking → marked. someone은 표시'되는' 것이므로 과거분사 marked가 적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① that: 주격 관계대명사. a way를 수식하는 절. 적절.
✅ ② marking → marked: 수동의 의미. '표시된' = marked. marking은 능동.
❌ ③ appear: 사역동사 make의 목적격보어(수동태)로 to부정사. 적절.
❌ ④ both: stupidity와 scolding 둘 다. 적절.
det.tip: 능동(-ing) vs 수동(-ed): someone marked as a bigot = 편견이 심한 사람으로 표시된 누군가

det.korean: ④ encouraging → to encourage. means를 수식하는 to부정사의 형용사적 용법.
det.analysis:
❌ ① has been addressed: 현재완료 수동태. Each(단수)에 맞는 동사. 적절.
❌ ② to make: help+(to)+동사원형. 적절.
❌ ③ made to appear: 수동태에서 사역동사 make의 보어는 to부정사. 적절.
✅ ④ encouraging → to encourage: means를 수식하는 to부정사. 원문은 means to encourage.
det.tip: means to V: '~하기 위한 수단'. to부정사의 형용사적 용법.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ was acted → acted. act as는 자동사 구문이므로 수동태 불가.
det.analysis:
❌ ① previously: 부사. '이전보다'의 의미. 적절.
❌ ② was then made: 수동태. 적절.
✅ ③ was acted → acted: act as(~로 작용하다)는 자동사. 수동태 불가.
❌ ④ tolerant: 형용사. society 수식. 적절.
det.tip: act as = ~로 작용하다 (자동사). 수동태 불가. acted (O) / was acted (X)

det.korean: ② praise(칭찬) → scolding(꾸지람). 인물이 '칭찬'이 아니라 '꾸지람'을 받아 체면을 잃음.

❌ ① stupidity: 어리석음. 적절.
✅ ② praise → scolding: 원문은 scolding(꾸지람). praise(칭찬)는 반의어.
❌ ③ acceptance: 수용. 적절.
❌ ④ pluralistic: 다원적인. 적절.

det.korean: 시트콤의 유머는 더 다원적이고 관용적인 사회의 수용을 장려하는 수단.

❌ ② a more traditional and conservative society: 진보적 가치와 반대.
❌ ④ a more isolated and independent society: 다원주의와 반대.

✅ acceptable: make의 목적격보어(형용사). 'values를 더 수용 가능하게 만들다'.
❌ acceptance: 명사형. 보어 자리에 부적절.
❌ accepted: 과거분사. more와 어울리지 않음.
det.tip: make + O + C(형용사): make values more acceptable

det.korean: 시트콤의 유머는 비용 효율적인 수단으로 작용했다.
det.analysis: ✅ the humour of sitcoms acted as a cost-effective means: 주어(the humour of sitcoms) + 동사(acted) + 보어(as a cost-effective means).
det.tip: act as = ~로 작용하다. the humour of sitcoms = 시트콤의 유머(주어)

det.korean: 유머를 통해 사회적 관용을 증진하는 미국 TV 시트콤의 역할.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 유머를 통해 사회적 관용을 증진하는 미국 TV 시트콤의 역할: 글의 핵심 주제.
❌ ① 미국 TV 시트콤의 역사적 발전 과정: 역사보다 유머의 기능이 핵심.

det.tip: 주제 = 글 전체를 관통하는 핵심. '유머 → 사회적 관용 증진'.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? "U.S. TV sitcoms have used (A)__________ to promote (B)__________ of diverse social values."

det.korean: 시트콤이 (A)유머를 사용하여 다양한 사회적 가치의 (B)수용을 촉진.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ humour — acceptance: 원문의 핵심 요약.
❌ ① drama — rejection: 드라마 아닌 유머, 거부 아닌 수용.
❌ ② humour — rejection: 유머는 맞지만 거부는 반대.
❌ ④ satire — criticism: 핵심 단어가 아님.
det.tip: 요약 = 핵심 키워드(humour, acceptance) 파악.

det.korean: acted as — 원문: 'acted as a cost-effective means'. '~로 작용했다' 과거형.
det.analysis:
✅ acted as: act as(~로 작용하다)의 과거형.
❌ acts as: 현재형. 과거형 조건 불충족.
❌ was acting: 과거진행형. 문맥에 부자연스러움.
det.tip: act as = ~로 작용하다. acted as = ~로 작용했다(과거)
